trello.name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Set up the three subscription tiers in Stripe with the following pricing and features: Basic ($29/month, basic AI model access), Pro ($49/month, additional features/priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month, all features/custom support). Ensure these are correctly reflected in the app backend and frontend pricing pages.

trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Integrate Stripe Elements for the checkout process, ensuring the form matches the app's clean design. Include a clear feature comparison for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and a tooltip/help icon explaining plan changes. Handle error states gracefully (e.g., invalid cards, insufficient funds) with clear user notifications. Deadline: Initial integration within 2 weeks.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard Subscription Features
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Build the user dashboard to display current plan details, billing info, invoices, and payment history. Implement functionality for users to upgrade, downgrade, cancel subscriptions, and update payment methods. Ensure real-time status updates and notifications for plan changes or payment failures. Coordinate with Taylor to ensure frontend changes reflect backend API states.

trello.name: Integrate Backend Stripe API and Webhooks
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Integrate Stripe API to handle subscription creation, payment processing, and management. Implement webhook handlers for specific events: invoice.payment_succeeded (activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify user, prompt payment update, send email), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage access rights, offer re-subscription). Document API endpoints and webhook handlers.

trello.name: Create and Execute Comprehensive Test Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor (lead), Jordan (support). Develop a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up to billing to management). Include specific scenarios for payment failures, cancellations, and edge cases. Execute tests during the designated one-week testing phase after the initial two-week development period. Ensure all edge cases are covered and system functions as expected.

trello.name: Draft User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan (lead), Taylor (support). Create a help section or FAQ covering common subscription issues, instructions for managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling payment errors. Ensure documentation is clear and available for users once the feature is live.

trello.name: Schedule and Conduct Progress Review Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on Stripe integration, address any blockers, and coordinate between frontend and backend teams. Ensure Jordan and Taylor provide updates on their respective tasks.
